lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five vertical columns. The spatial distribution follows a grid-like pattern with increasing inter-centroid distance in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define the lateral grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four distinct, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes consistent with commensal organisms (remoras) located near the ventral-posterior edge of the left pectoral fin and the lower flank.
